note: tasks.json keeps its blueprint name for tooling continuity; each entry is a Work Unit — one coherent, independently verifiable, single-session unit of construction. Right-sizing tests T1-T3 = (T1) fits one agent session, (T2) independently verifiable against its verification_ref, (T3) does not silently bundle more than one story's worth of behavior.
